value.0: A scribe of Gondor, sent north with the wizards' expedition to catalogue the lore of ruined Annuminas. She looks up from her ledgers with keen, worried eyes.

This coffer bears no keyhole a picklock could ever fool -- only the Annuminas Key will turn it, and only the once. A faint heat pulses from within, as though something bred of raw, untutored power slumbers here. The Numenoreans warded such coffers for those born to the Art, not schooled in it.

Wrought in Numenor for those born to the wild fire of the Art rather than schooled in it, this piece hums faintly of raw, untutored power. It answers to Charisma and to instinct, widening the channels through which a sorcerer's innate magic pours.

Sigils of the loremasters are graven deep into the iron bands, and no thief's tools will ever move them -- the Annuminas Key alone unseals it, and but a single time. Within rests the disciplined, catalogued craft of Numenor's studied mages, set aside for one who has earned their learning.

A relic of Numenor's studied loremasters, graven with the disciplined sigils of the Academy. It sharpens the intellect and rewards patient learning, unsealing memorized spellcraft for one who has earned their knowledge.
